Callout.Name: Farmhouse Alarm
Callout.Message: Alarm at a remote farmhouse, keyholder an hour away.
Callout.Advisory: No persons seen, driveway gates open.

Script.Line: It is a monitored alarm and the keyholder is an hour away.
Last time it was a barn door in the wind. This is the house.
I am not going in on my own and there is nobody else out here.

Lines.Approach: The gates are open and the keyholder is an hour out. Approach like somebody is still inside.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
